sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
Easter eggs and References:
- The term "killer cyborg from the future" is a reference to the The Terminator movies, which is translated into "Cyborg Killer" in Russia.
- The logo on the casette cover refers to the content creator cyborgkiller.
